item.title: The Black Panther - Secret of the White Witch (Unique Art) T-Shirt
item.description: This art is the front cover of an Afrikaans series of books from the 1980's, called "Die Swart Luiperd Reeks". The authors of this particular series was Braam le Roux and Meiring Fouche. This cover is the 18th story book in this exciting series.

item.title: Fourier Transform Deinonychus - Math Dinosaur T-Shirt
item.description: This design was created using a custom-coded application programmed to trace the Deinonychus outline using Fourier transform math. Rather than a standard text-to-image AI generation, this piece features authentic mathematical plotting, with the body details filled in using the actual FFT equations from the process.
